query: What is the total home office stipend for a newly hired team member, and how is it expensed?
gold_answer: New hires receive a $1,500 USD (or local currency equivalent) stipend to set up their home office during their first year. Items must be purchased out-of-pocket and expensed in Navan under 'Work From Home - New Hire Stipend'.

query: Can existing team members get an office refresh every year?
gold_answer: Yes, existing team members receive an annual refresh stipend of $500 USD (or local currency equivalent) to purchase upgrades. This resets January 1 to December 31 and applies only to team members employed the entire previous calendar year. It excludes laptops.

query: Are treadmills or walking pads reimbursable under the home office stipend?
gold_answer: No. Non-reimbursable items include treadmills, walking pads, smart TVs, phones, watches, smart speakers, tablets, bookshelves, and Wi-Fi mesh routers.

query: What is the daily meal reimbursement limit for a team member traveling on company business?
gold_answer: Meals while traveling on company business are reimbursable up to $120 USD (or local currency equivalent) per day. Tips up to 20% must fit within this limit.

query: What is the per-person limit for team events and meals while traveling?
gold_answer: The limit is $80 USD per person per meal. The most senior team member present should pay and expense the total bill if separate receipts aren't practical.

query: When is business class airfare permitted for international travel?
gold_answer: Business class is permitted for frequent travelers (3+ international trips per quarter) on flights exceeding 8 hours of continuous flight time, when traveling to meet customers, speak, or represent GitLab at a conference.

query: What is the maximum monthly reimbursement threshold in Navan before AP approval is required?
gold_answer: The maximum monthly reimbursement limit is $10,000 USD (or local currency equivalent). E-Group members have a maximum of $20,000 USD.

query: Can I expense my personal VPN subscription?
gold_answer: No. Effective July 15, 2026, GitLab no longer reimburses personal VPN subscriptions. Team members must use NordLayer, GitLab's corporate VPN solution.

query: What is the monthly allowance limit for co-working space rental?
gold_answer: Co-working space is reimbursable up to $700 USD per month for dedicated workspace rental within commutable distance of your primary residence. Pre-approval is required if booking more than 5 days a month.

query: Can I expense both home internet and a monthly co-working space simultaneously?
gold_answer: No. If a team member expenses a co-working space for a full month, home internet cannot be expensed.

query: What is the monthly reimbursement cap for home internet and mobile phone service?
gold_answer: Both home internet and vital mobile phone service are capped at up to $100 USD each per month. Hardware/setup costs are excluded.

query: What is the gift policy limit when a manager sends flowers or gifts for significant life events?
gold_answer: People Managers can expense qualified gifts or flowers up to $125 USD (including shipping) per transaction. Cash and gift cards are strictly prohibited.

query: What is Compass?
gold_answer: Compass is GitLab's centralized IT, People, and business-service support platform, utilizing Serval, an AI-native ITSM platform.

query: What are the SLAs for Compass queries to People Operations?
gold_answer: Initial case acknowledgement is within 24 hours. Tier 01 resolves in <= 24 hours; Tier 02 resolves in <= 72 hours; Tier 03 hands off in <= 24 hours.

query: What is the turn-around time for employment verification?
gold_answer: The People Operations team fulfills employment verifications and letters of employment within 24 hours.

query: How do team members report an inaccurate LinkedIn profile claiming to work at GitLab?
gold_answer: Verify the person in Slack. If unconfirmed, open a Compass case. People Ops checks Workday and TA. If unaffiliated, TA creates a 'Do Not Hire' profile and People Ops reports the account to LinkedIn.

query: What anonymous reporting hotlines are available?
gold_answer: Team members can report anonymously via Ethico for Code of Conduct violations or Lighthouse Services for workplace conduct/harassment.

query: What constitutes Job Abandonment?
gold_answer: Unexcused absence for three consecutive workdays without an entry on the availability calendar and failure to contact one's supervisor constitutes job abandonment.

query: What are the classification levels for harassment disciplinary action?
gold_answer: Level 1: First-time occurrence. Level 2: Recurring socially inappropriate behavior. Level 3: Major infraction or retaliation. Level 4: Serious cases/criminal offenses.

query: What are the rules regarding romantic or family relationships at work?
gold_answer: Permitted only if candidates/team members do not supervise each other, do not occupy the same line of authority regarding hiring/wages, and do not have access to sensitive personnel files of the relative.

query: What is the maximum consecutive duration an employee can take under Flexible Paid Time Off?
gold_answer: Team members can take up to 25 consecutive calendar days for vacation under the Flexible PTO policy.

query: Who is the third-party administrator for leaves of absence in the US and Canada?
gold_answer: Effective February 2, 2026, Tilt serves as the TPA for leaves in the US and Canada. In Canada, Tilt administers parental leaves only.

query: What are the emergency benefits under the Chubb Business Travel Accident Policy?
gold_answer: Accidental Death: 5x annual salary up to $500k; Out of Country medical: up to $250k; Emergency medical: up to $10k; Security evacuation: max $100k; Baggage delay/loss: up to $2,500.

query: What is the annual limit of the Growth and Development Fund?
gold_answer: GitLab provides up to $10,000 USD per calendar year for professional career development, subject to tenure, performance, and budget.

query: How much does GitLab cover under the Travel Health Reimbursement (HRA)?
gold_answer: Pre-tax account covers up to $2,100 for eligible travel expenses, and a post-tax account covers up to $900 for expenses exceeding the pre-tax limit (administered by Navia).

query: How long can a terminating US employee continue medical coverage under COBRA?
gold_answer: Eligible employees can continue medical, dental, and vision coverage through COBRA for up to 18 months, administered by WEX (Discovery Benefits).

query: What are the plan monthly rates for ARAG Legal Insurance?
gold_answer: UltimateAdvisor plan is $18.25/month; UltimateAdvisor Plus plan is $20.90/month.

query: What is the maximum monthly pre-tax commuter benefit limit for parking and transit?
gold_answer: Up to $340/month for parking and up to $340/month for transit, administered through WEX.

query: What are the two primary tiers of paid sick leave in GitLab Canada Corp?
gold_answer: 10 days of annual sick leave at regular entitlement. For extended sick leave (5+ days), GitLab supplements pay up to 100% of regular salary for up to 25 working days.

query: What are the purchase limits under Ireland's Bike to Work scheme?
gold_answer: Regular bicycle: up to 1,250 EUR; Electric bike: up to 1,500 EUR; Cargo bike: up to 3,000 EUR. Available once every 4 years.

query: Who is the group insurance carrier for GitLab Korea Limited?
gold_answer: Meritz provides group medical and risk insurance, with GitLab covering 100% of premiums for team members and eligible dependents.

query: What types of leave does Tilt administer for GitLab team members in Canada?
gold_answer: In Canada, Tilt administers parental leaves only. Absence Management handles medical and caregiving leaves.

query: What are the provincial statutory sick leave requirements for Ontario and Quebec?
gold_answer: Ontario provides 3 days of job-protected unpaid sick leave. Quebec provides 2 days of paid absence per calendar year.

query: What are the contact channels to reach Tilt for US and Canada leave support?
gold_answer: Email LeaveSupport@ourtilt.com, use the contact form, or text (970) 449-0178.

query: How many days of paid leave are provided in Ireland for domestic violence?
gold_answer: Team members receive 5 paid days per year for domestic violence support services.

query: When is a medical certificate required for illness or sick leave in Ireland?
gold_answer: A medical certificate is required for any absence of 3 successive calendar days or more.

query: Can work-related recurring expenses like home internet be expensed while on a leave of absence?
gold_answer: No. All work-related expenses are not reimbursable while on leave of any kind.

query: What is GitLab's policy on parental leave eligibility?
gold_answer: GitLab provides paid Parental Leave for any team member, regardless of gender, who becomes a parent through childbirth or adoption.

query: Does the U.S. Fair Labor Standards Act mandate paid time off for vacations or sick leave?
gold_answer: No. The FLSA does not require employers to provide payment for time not worked, such as vacations or sick leave.

query: How are team member accounts handled if placed on leave during an internal investigation?
gold_answer: TMR coordinates with Legal and IT to disable account access, configures an Out of Office message, and issues a 'Team Member Suspension Letter' via DocuSign to their personal email.

query: What is a Directly Responsible Individual (DRI)?
gold_answer: A DRI is the person ultimately accountable for the success or failure of a specific project, initiative, or activity, holding final decision-making power while consulting stakeholders.

query: How does GitLab define 'Key Talent' during talent assessments?
gold_answer: Key Talent represents ~10% of the workforce who surpass performance expectations, demonstrate outsized business impact, and possess high growth potential. A SPOF is not automatically Key Talent.

query: What are the three pillars of GitLab's Talent Brand vision?
gold_answer: 1. Candidate Education to Support Conversion; 2. Evolved Brand Messaging ('Co-Create the Future'); 3. Elevated Candidate Journey.

query: What are the main responsibilities of a Support Training Module Maintainer?
gold_answer: Maintainers review merge requests modifying training module content, perform bi-annual sanity checks, and make lifecycle decisions (refresh, restructure, or deprecate).

query: What is the recruitment process for a Customer Support Engineer candidate?
gold_answer: 1. Online application; 2. Written asynchronous take-home assessment; 3. 40-minute screening call; 4. 90-minute live Technical Interview with break-fix scenarios.

query: How long does a candidate have to submit the Customer Support take-home assessment?
gold_answer: Candidates have 6 calendar days to complete and submit the take-home assessment.

query: What tool is used by the Candidate Experience Specialist (CES) team to schedule interviews?
gold_answer: ModernLoop is used to schedule interviews, integrated with Google Workspace, Greenhouse, Zoom, and Slack.

query: Within what timeframe should an interviewer decline an interview invitation if unable to attend?
gold_answer: Interviewers must decline within 24-48 hours of receiving the calendar invite by clicking 'No' and supplying a reason.

query: How far back does GitLab conduct employment background checks?
gold_answer: Background verification covers the last 5 years of employment history and/or the 3 most recent employers, administered by Sterling/First Advantage.

query: What is the typical probationary period duration in Australia?
gold_answer: 6 months, with a 1-week notice period during probation.

query: Do USA team members have a statutory probationary period under GitLab contracts?
gold_answer: No, team members in USA - Inc and USA - Federal LLC do not have probationary periods.

query: How does GitLab handle outside employment, side projects, and open source work?
gold_answer: Outside activities must not conflict with work or compete with GitLab. Prior written approval must be obtained from the direct manager, Team Member Relations, and Director/E-group leader.

query: What is the recommended cash compensation increase for an internal promotion?
gold_answer: The Total Rewards team recommends an increase between 5% and 10%. Anything over 10% requires special business justification.

query: How long should an interim management period typically last?
gold_answer: An interim period should last no less than 30 days and no more than 4 months.

query: When does an Organization Change Checklist get opened?
gold_answer: Opened when a team member migrates from Manager to Individual Contributor (Mgr+ to IC) or migrates teams (change in both manager and cost center).

query: At what time on a departing team member's last working day is offboarding deprovisioning initiated?
gold_answer: Offboarding cases in Compass are opened automatically between 4:00 PM and 5:00 PM of the departing team member's local time zone in Slack.

query: What is the SLA for system owners to deprovision access during offboarding?
gold_answer: Tasks must be completed within 5 working days. Critical/time-sensitive tools (e.g., Slack, SOX systems) must be revoked within the first 24 hours.

query: What is the property return threshold for GitLab equipment upon departure?
gold_answer: Any GitLab property valued above $1,000 USD must be returned upon offboarding. For laptops, contact gitlab-laptop-recovery@gitlab.com.

query: Who is eligible to join the #gitlab-alumni Slack channel?
gold_answer: All voluntary exits in good standing are eligible. Involuntary exits are not eligible unless specifically approved by Team Member Relations.

query: What are the anniversary gift milestones recognized by GitLab?
gold_answer: Milestones recognized with anniversary gifts are the 1st, 3rd, 5th, and 10th year anniversaries.

query: What is the minimum tenure required before a team member is eligible for a long-term relocation?
gold_answer: A team member must have satisfied a minimum of one year of continuous tenure at GitLab to be eligible to apply for long-term relocation.

query: What is the maximum number of days a team member can work outside their primary residence without triggering a long-term relocation?
gold_answer: Up to 183 days per calendar year. Exceeding this triggers permanent establishment/tax liabilities.

query: To which country does GitLab provide immigration visa sponsorship for employee relocations?
gold_answer: GitLab only provides immigration sponsorship for relocations to the Netherlands. For other countries, team members must have independent work rights.

query: What happens to compensation when relocating to a region with a different location factor?
gold_answer: Salary is adjusted up or down to align with the new location factor, maintaining the team member's existing compa-ratio within the new location's range.

query: Can a team member travel to or work from Cuba, Iran, or Syria on a GitLab laptop?
gold_answer: No. Team members cannot take company-owned devices to or work from US-embargoed countries under any circumstances.

query: How many days before a planned international relocation must a team member submit their Compass request?
gold_answer: Team members must submit their request no later than 3 months prior to their ideal international relocation date (or 30 days prior for domestic moves).

query: What effective dates are required for an international relocation?
gold_answer: Effective dates must fall on the 1st or 16th of the month to avoid tax and absence accrual complications.

query: Is E-Group approval required for any relocation?
gold_answer: Yes, if the relocation results in a location factor increase of 0.20 or greater, VP and E-Group approval is required before manager approval.

query: Does GitLab cover relocation costs for the team member's family members?
gold_answer: No. Even for the Netherlands, GitLab does not cover relocation costs for the team member's family members.

query: Can a team member relocate to a country where GitLab does not have an established entity?
gold_answer: No. GitLab only allows relocations to countries where an entity is formally established, open for hiring, and carries no hiring restrictions.

query: What is the statutory probationary period and notice period for team members in GitLab India?
gold_answer: GitLab India has a probationary period of 6 months. The notice period during probation is 1 week, and after probation is 1 month.

query: What Provident Fund (PF) options must a team member choose when relocating to India?
gold_answer: Team members must select between an uncapped percentage-based contribution (12% of basic salary per month) or a capped amount of 1,800 INR per month.

query: How does a team member enroll in the National Pension System (NPS) when relocating to India?
gold_answer: Team members who want to enroll in the NPS must submit their Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) via the designated enrollment form.

query: What workspace location is configured in Workday for team members relocating to India?
gold_answer: The workspace configured in Workday under the 'Change Location' business process is Karnataka.

query: How is IT equipment handled when a team member relocates to or from India?
gold_answer: IT Ops arranges local laptop procurement in India and confirms refresh eligibility. The existing laptop must be disposed of at the originating entity prior to relocation.

query: What specific workplace conduct policies exist for GitLab India Private Limited?
gold_answer: GitLab India maintains the Policy Against Sexual Harassment (POSH Policy) and the Equal Opportunity Policy (EOP Policy).

query: Where can team members find the exact process for managing sexual harassment complaints under GitLab India?
gold_answer: The procedures and formal processes for managing complaints of sexual harassment are set out in the GitLab India Private Limited Policy Against Sexual Harassment.

query: Which official body in India does GitLab cite as responsible for declaring natural disasters?
gold_answer: The Office of Disaster Management in India is responsible for declaring and directing emergency and relief efforts around natural disasters.

query: Can an Indian employee working under GitLab India use a personal VPN subscription like ExpressVPN?
gold_answer: No. Across all GitLab entities, personal VPN reimbursement was discontinued on July 15, 2026. All team members must use NordLayer.

query: What is the maximum consecutive duration an employee in India can take under Flexible Paid Time Off?
gold_answer: Team members globally, including in India, can take up to 25 consecutive calendar days for vacation under the Flexible Paid Time Off policy.

query: I'm a new hire. If I use my full home-office stipend and also expense a dedicated co-working space at the maximum rate every month of my first year, what is the most I can be reimbursed in total, and can I also expense home internet in those months?
gold_answer: Up to 9,900 USD: the 1,500 USD new-hire home office stipend plus 12 × 700 USD (8,400 USD) for co-working. Co-working needs pre-approval. If a co-working space is expensed for a full month, home internet cannot be expensed for that month.

query: On a 4-day business trip, what is the maximum I can be reimbursed for my own meals in total, and what limit applies if one of those meals is a team dinner?
gold_answer: Up to 480 USD for the trip (120 USD per day × 4 days). A team meal is limited to 80 USD per person per meal; tips (up to 20%) must stay within the limit, and the most senior team member present should pay if separate bills aren't practical.

query: If my phone is vital to my role and I expense both home internet and phone service at the maximum allowed every month, what is my annual total?
gold_answer: 2,400 USD per year: home internet up to 100 USD/month plus phone service up to 100 USD/month (only for team members whose phones are vital to their position), i.e. 200 USD × 12.

query: I joined GitLab in June 2025. In calendar year 2026, can I claim the 500 USD home-office refresh, and what is the most I could receive in 2026 from the refresh and the Growth and Development Fund combined?
gold_answer: No refresh in 2026: the 500 USD yearly refresh only applies to team members employed for the entire previous calendar year, and you joined mid-2025. So the combined maximum for 2026 is 10,000 USD from the Growth and Development Fund alone (you would become eligible for the refresh in 2027).
reasoning_path: refresh rule: employed entire previous calendar year (p55)

query: I've been at GitLab for 8 months and want to relocate from the US to the Netherlands next month. Is that possible?
gold_answer: No. Long-term relocation requires at least one year of tenure, and for a move to another country the process must start no later than 3 months before the ideal relocation date. (The Netherlands is the one country GitLab sponsors relocations to, so the destination itself is allowed.)

query: My relocation would raise my location factor from 0.65 to 0.90. Who has to approve it, and which dates can the relocation take effect on?
gold_answer: The increase is 0.25, which is at least 0.20, so it needs VP approval and then E-Group member approval before manager approval. For a move to a new country the effective date must be the 1st or 16th of the month (the 1st for sales roles with a variable change).

query: A manager proposes a 12% cash increase for an internal promotion. Is that within the usual guideline, and what extra is needed?
gold_answer: It is above the guideline: Total Rewards typically recommends a 5%-10% increase for a promotion. An increase of more than 10% requires additional business justification to the Total Rewards team and the executive approver, added as a comment in the promotion worksheet.

query: As a US team member, what is the maximum I can set aside per year in pre-tax commuter benefits if I use both the parking and transit benefits?
gold_answer: 8,160 USD per year: up to 340 USD/month for parking plus up to 340 USD/month for transit (680 USD × 12), through WEX; unused funds roll over month to month.

query: I want to take five weeks of vacation in a row under flexible PTO. Can I just take it after telling my manager?
gold_answer: No. Five weeks (35 days) is more than 25 consecutive calendar days (counting weekends and holidays), so special permission is required from your Manager, your People Business Partner and the Absence Management team (leaves@gitlab.com).

query: I'm leaving GitLab. Do I have to return a 400 USD monitor I bought with company funds, and what about my laptop?
gold_answer: The monitor doesn't fall under the return rule: only GitLab property valued above 1,000 USD must be returned. Laptops follow the Laptop Buyback Policy, under which you may, at GitLab's discretion, keep or buy back the laptop.

query: How much earlier do I need to start the relocation process for a move to another country than for a move within the same country?
gold_answer: About two months earlier: an international move must start no later than 3 months before the ideal relocation date, while a move within the same country needs only 30 days' notice.

query: Six of us are having a team dinner while travelling on company business. What is the maximum total that can be reimbursed, and who should pay?
gold_answer: Up to 480 USD in total (80 USD per person per meal × 6), including tips of up to 20%. If separate billing isn't practical, the most senior team member present should pay the bill and submit it for reimbursement.
